extension.summary: Blurred backgrounds, keymaps and faster info pages for the Bald skin.
extension.description: A small service for the Bald skin. While Bald is the active skin and its blurred background is on, it blurs the fanart of the item Bald's background follows and keeps the results in a small cache, so Bald no longer needs TMDb Helper for its backgrounds. While Bald is the active skin and Bald Settings, Appearance, Behavior, "Open TV shows on their info page" is on, it installs a keymap so that Select on a TV show in the video library opens the show's information page instead of its seasons. It removes the keymap when the setting is off, under any other skin, and when Kodi exits or the add-on is disabled. It also runs Bald's information page, episode playback, More like this, Series page and letter bar actions in its running service, so they no longer start a new Python script each time; without the add-on Bald runs them as scripts as before.
